name: Aokie Speech-to-Text
description: The Aokie receptionist's ears: streaming speech recognition for a live phone call, served locally over the OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions API. Installs the Parakeet ONNX weights (~663 MB), every file checksum-verified against the plugin's own manifest.

files.install-aokie-stt.ps1:
# install-aokie-voice.ps1  <bundle>
#
# Installs ONE voice-model bundle for the Aokie plugin's local speech server.
#
# Driven entirely by the plugin's OWN models-manifest.json rather than a copy of
# its URLs: the plugin ships that file, it pins an immutable HuggingFace
# revision, and it carries a SHA-256 and a byte size for every file. Reading it
# means this installer cannot drift out of step with the plugin it serves, and
# that a plugin update which repoints a model needs no change here.
#
# Every file is verified before the bundle is promoted. These are ~800 MB of
# ONNX weights that the receptionist loads into a live phone call; a truncated
# or substituted encoder is not something to discover mid-conversation.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Which bundle this service needs. The rest of this script is generic.
$bundleName = 'parakeet'

$dataDir     = $env:OAIY_DATA_DIR
$modelsDir   = $env:OAIY_MODELS_DIR
if (-not $dataDir)   { throw "OAIY_DATA_DIR is not set" }
if (-not $modelsDir) { $modelsDir = Join-Path $dataDir 'models' }

$manifestPath = Join-Path $dataDir 'plugins\aokie\models-manifest.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $manifestPath)) {
  throw "the Aokie plugin is not installed ($manifestPath not found) - install the plugin first, then this service"
}

$manifest = Get-Content $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$bundle = $manifest.bundles | Where-Object { $_.name -eq $bundleName } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $bundle) { throw "no bundle '$bundleName' in the plugin's models-manifest.json" }

$dest    = Join-Path $modelsDir "aokie\$bundleName"
$staging = "$dest.partial"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $staging | Out-Null

$total = ($bundle.files | Measure-Object -Property size -Sum).Sum
Write-Output "installing $bundleName ($([math]::Round($total/1MB)) MB) - $($bundle.description)"
Write-Output "license: $($bundle.license)  $($bundle.licenseUrl)"

foreach ($f in $bundle.files) {
  $target = Join-Path $staging $f.path
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $target -Parent) | Out-Null

  # Already here and correct? Re-running an install after a failure partway
  # through should not re-download 650 MB it already has.
  if (Test-Path $target) {
    if ((Get-Item $target).Length -eq $f.size -and
        (Get-FileHash $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -eq $f.sha256.ToLower()) {
      Write-Output "  ok (cached)  $($f.path)"
      continue
    }
    Remove-Item $target -Force
  }

  $prefix = if ($bundle.source.pathPrefix) { "$($bundle.source.pathPrefix)/" } else { "" }
  $url = "$($bundle.source.baseUrl)$prefix$($f.path)"
  Write-Output "  downloading  $($f.path)  ($([math]::Round($f.size/1MB)) MB)"

  $tmp = "$target.part"
  # Invoke-WebRequest's progress bar makes large downloads dramatically slower
  # in a non-interactive host, and this output is piped to the service log.
  $oldPref = $ProgressPreference
  $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
  try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $tmp -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 5
  } finally {
    $ProgressPreference = $oldPref
  }

  $len = (Get-Item $tmp).Length
  if ($len -ne $f.size) {
    Remove-Item $tmp -Force
    throw "$($f.path): expected $($f.size) bytes, got $len"
  }
  $got = (Get-FileHash $tmp -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
  if ($got -ne $f.sha256.ToLower()) {
    Remove-Item $tmp -Force
    throw "$($f.path): checksum mismatch - expected $($f.sha256), got $got"
  }
  Move-Item $tmp $target -Force
  Write-Output "  verified     $($f.path)"
}

# Promote only once every file in the bundle has been verified, so a half
# downloaded set is never visible under the name the server loads from.
if (Test-Path $dest) { Remove-Item $dest -Recurse -Force }
Move-Item $staging $dest -Force

New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path (Join-Path $dest '.oaiy-installed') | Out-Null
Write-Output "$bundleName installed to $dest"
